map.根据当地无霜期与作物生育期，推算安全播种窗口与收获日期。: From local frost-free period and crop growth days, estimate safe sowing window and harvest date.
map.最晚播种日 = 无霜期初日 + 安全余量；预计收获日 = 最晚播种日 + 生育期: Latest sowing = frost-free start + safety margin; expected harvest = latest sowing + growth; safety margin days = frost-free end - expected harvest
map.以当地无霜期初日与终日构成安全窗口：先加安全余量得最晚播种日，再加作物生育期得预: Local frost-free start and end form the safe window: add safety margin to get latest sowing, then add growth to get expected harvest. Safety margin days = frost-free end - expected harvest; >=0 means harvest before frost, window sufficient; negative warns frost risk, suggesting earlier sowing or early-maturing variety. Total frost-free days = date difference.
map.💡 公式：最晚播种日 = 无霜期初日 + 安全余量；安全收获日 = 最晚播种日: 💡 Formula: Latest sowing = frost-free start + safety margin; safe harvest = latest sowing + growth period
map.无霜期数据可通过当地气象站或农业部门获取: Frost-free data from local weather station or agriculture department
map.安全余量用于应对晚霜、低温出苗慢等风险，一般取 7–15 天: Safety margin covers late frost and slow cold germination, usually 7-15 days
map.生育期应参考具体品种在当地的实际表现: Growth period should reference the variety's local performance
map.安全播期 = 终霜日 + 苗期耐霜裕度，或 = 初霜日 − 生育期 − 缓冲。: Safe sowing = last-frost + seedling frost tolerance, or = first-frost - growth - buffer.
map.喜温作物以终霜后地温稳定通过 10~12℃ 为适播指标。: Warm-loving crops: stable soil temp through 10-12°C after last frost is the sowing indicator.
map.用于春玉米、棉花、大豆等作物的适播窗口确定。: For spring corn, cotton, soybean sowing-window determination.
map.当地终霜 4 月 10 日，大豆出苗需地温稳定 ≥10℃ 且苗期耐轻霜。以终霜后: Local last frost Apr 10; soybean emergence needs stable soil >=10°C and light-frost tolerance. Use last-frost+5 days (Apr 15) as lower bound; with 5 cm soil temp measured, if past 10°C, sow; latest by May 10 to mature before autumn frost.
map.终霜日和初霜日哪个更关键？: Which is more critical, last or first frost?
map.春播看终霜（防苗期冻害），秋熟看初霜（防贪青受冻）。两者共同框定安全生长期的上下: Spring sowing watches last frost (prevent seedling freeze); autumn maturity watches first frost (prevent late greening freeze). Together they bound the safe growth period.
map.地温比气温更准吗？: Is soil temperature more accurate than air temperature?
map.对播种而言地温更准，因为种子萌发取决于种床温度而非气温。5~10 cm 地温是农: For sowing, soil temp is more accurate since germination depends on seedbed temp, not air. 5-10 cm soil temp quantifies the folk saying "ground warmth arrives".
map.播种日期计算器帮助种植者根据当地无霜期长度、作物生育期和安全余量，确定最晚安全播: The Sowing Date Calculator helps growers set the latest safe sowing date and expected harvest from frost-free length, growth period, and safety margin, avoiding frost risk.
